test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The average age of 14 students of a class is 17 years. If a new student of age 32 years joins the class, then what will be the average age of these 15 students?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Average Age = (Total Age of Students) / (Number of Students)

**Calculation:**

Total age of 14 students = 14 × 17 = 238 years

Age of new student = 32 years

Total age of 15 students = 238 + 32 = 270 years

⇒ Average age of 15 students = 270 / 15

⇒ Average age of 15 students = 18 years

**∴ The correct answer is 18 years.**
